Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct.question: Cual fue el producto top en ingresos de cada trimestre del semestre, y cambio el lider entre el primer y el segundo trimestre?
Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct.model_output:
```sql
WITH QuarterSales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.name AS product_name,
        SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales,
        DATE_FORMAT(s.sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS quarter
    FROM 
        products p
    JOIN 
        sales s ON p.product_id = s.product_id
    GROUP BY 
        p.product_id, quarter
),
QuarterSalesRanked AS (
    SELECT 
        product_name,
        total_sales,
        quarter,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        QuarterSales
)
SELECT 
    quarter,
    product_name,
    total_sales
FROM 
    QuarterSalesRanked
WHERE 
    rank = 1;
```
